2 ” to allow audio playback Hello grade four learner. Welcome to our social studies lesson. Today, we are going to learn about the qualities of a good leader in the community . In the previous lesson, we learned about community leaders in the county. Let us remind ourselves a few things that we learned. Learner, Who is a leader? Who is a leader? #Bell# Well done. A leader is the head of a group who shared the same interests or goals. A leader is the head of a group who share the same interests or goals. We also learned that community leaders had duties this include. Uniting the community they lead, uniting the community they lead. Maintaining law and order in the community thus promoting peace and harmony, maintaining law and order in the community thus promoting peace and harmony. Resolving disputes among community members, resolving disputes among community members and Protect the interests of all their members, protect the interest of all their members. For example, in today's situation with the Corona virus pandemic, community leaders are working round the clock in helping to curb the spread of the corona virus by encouraging their members to; Wear masks Wash their hands regularly, and Sanitize their hands. Learner, how else has your community leader adviced you to do to help in stopping the spread of the Corona virus? How else has your community leader advised you to do to help in stopping the spread of the Corona virus? #Bell# Well done . I hope your answer was, keep the social distance. Who are the leaders at school? Who are your leaders at school? #Bell# What do you like about your leaders? What do you like about your leaders? #Bell#

3 ” to allow audio playback Well done. A good leader should have the following qualities , Honest. Honesty is when you speak the truth and act truthfully. It is not doing what is wrong. Therefore, the leader should do what is right for the community. He or she should be just and fair to all members in the community. A good leader should listen and learn from others. He should listen and learn from others. A good leader should lead by example. A good leader should lead by example. A good leader should inspire others. A good leader should inspire others. A good leader should bring people together. A good leader should bring people together that is unite people in the community they lead. A good leader is humble. He is humble. A good leader thinks about the future of the community. He thinks about the future of the community. A good leader is trusted. He is trusted. A good leader helps the needy. He helps the needy in his community. And A good leader helps in conserving the environment, he helps in conserving the environment. Qualities of a bad leader include. They are corrupt. Corruption is the practice of buying a favor from another person. It is the practice of buying a favor from another person. They are selfish. They are selfish They do not listen to anyone. They do not listen to anyone. They do what they think is right to them. They are not obedient to the rule of law. They are not obedient to the rule of law. and They can not be trusted. They can not be trusted. Anyone can be a leader. You can learn good leadership skills and become a great leader. In conclusion, if you were a village elder in your community, what would you do to show you are a good leader today? #Bell# And with that, we come to the end of our lesson for today. Until next time, keep safe. Goodbye.
